const raw = $input.first()?.json ?? {};
return [{ json: {
  source: 'ORCHESTRATOR_AUTOMATIC_SELECTION',
  orchestrator_execution_id: String(raw.orchestrator_execution_id ?? ''),
  radar_execution_id: String(raw.radar_execution_id ?? ''),
  correlation_id: String(raw.correlation_id ?? ''),
  idempotency_key: String(raw.idempotency_key ?? ''),
  selection_policy_version: String(raw.selection_policy_version ?? ''),
  selection_method: String(raw.selection_method ?? ''),
  selection_status: String(raw.selection_status ?? ''),
  selection_digest: String(raw.selection_digest ?? ''),
  selected_candidate_id: String(raw.selected_candidate_id ?? ''),
  evaluated_candidates: Array.isArray(raw.evaluated_candidates) ? raw.evaluated_candidates : [],
  ranking: Array.isArray(raw.ranking) ? raw.ranking : [],
  selection_reason_codes: Array.isArray(raw.selection_reason_codes) ? raw.selection_reason_codes : [],
  candidate: raw.candidate && typeof raw.candidate === 'object' ? raw.candidate : null,
} }];

const data = $input.first().json;
const humanReviewSelection = data.selection.selection_tier === 'HUMAN_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE';
return [{ json: {
  project_key: data.configuration.project_key,
  workflow_key: data.configuration.workflow_key,
  workflow_version: data.configuration.workflow_version,
  schema_version: data.configuration.schema_version,
  status: data.selection.status,
  selected_automatically: true,
  human_topic_approval_required: humanReviewSelection,
  selection_tier: data.selection.selection_tier,
  candidate_id: data.selection.selected_candidate_id,
  content_factory_input: data.content_factory_input,
  approved_sources: data.approved_sources,
  selection_audit: data.content_factory_input.selection_audit,
  warnings: data.warnings ?? [],
  checkpoints: [...data.checkpoints, humanReviewSelection ? 'CONTENT_FACTORY_HUMAN_REVIEW_DRAFT_CONTRACT_READY' : 'CONTENT_FACTORY_AUTOMATIC_SELECTION_CONTRACT_READY'],
} }];

const data = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  project_key: data.configuration?.project_key ?? 'ia-das-vagas-content-factory',
  workflow_key: data.configuration?.workflow_key ?? 'topic-selection',
  workflow_version: data.configuration?.workflow_version ?? '0.3.8',
  schema_version: data.configuration?.schema_version ?? '1.2.0',
  status: 'TIERED_SELECTION_BLOCKED',
  selected_automatically: false,
  human_topic_approval_required: false,
  selection_tier: 'REJECTED',
  candidate_id: data.selection?.selected_candidate_id ?? null,
  content_factory_input: null,
  approved_sources: data.approved_sources ?? [],
  selection_audit: null,
  warnings: data.warnings ?? [],
  checkpoints: [...(data.checkpoints ?? []), 'CONTENT_FACTORY_TIERED_SELECTION_CONTRACT_BLOCKED'],
} }];
